IPHONE 16 PRO MAX - 3D MODEL PACKAGE

Files:
- iPhone_16_Pro_Max.obj       Main 3D geometry (Wavefront OBJ)
- iphone16promax_model.mtl    Material definitions
- screen_texture.png          Full-color screen texture from the supplied screenshot

IMPORTANT:
Keep the OBJ, MTL, and PNG files together in the same folder.
Import iPhone_16_Pro_Max.obj in Blender using File > Import > Wavefront (.obj).
Use Material Preview or Rendered view to see the colors and screen texture.
The model uses millimeter units. The main body dimensions follow the iPhone 16 Pro Max published dimensions; small details are a visual reconstruction, not Apple's manufacturing CAD data.
